compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from an app called "Make Your Song." The main function of this screen is to record your voice. The central feature is a large circular button with a square in the middle, which likely serves as the record button. 

At the top, there is a header with the app's name "Make Your Song" and a "Menu" option. Below the record button, there are instructions in small text:
- "Click Play button to listen to the music you have mixed and to create your lyrics and your melody."
- "Click Microphone button to record your voice over the music you have chosen."

At the bottom of the screen, there is an advertisement banner. The status bar at the top shows various icons and the time (9:05).

reason: Tapping this icon means recording the voice
